def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv"

    # Row 0 is a title, row 1 is blank, row 2 contains the real header.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, skiprows=2)

    # Normalize column names (strip spaces)
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]

    # Drop fully-empty rows and keep only 4-digit years (removes blank/footer rows)
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[df['Year'].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}")].copy()

    # Parse numeric columns (remove thousands separators)
    for c in ['Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = (
                df[c]
                .astype(str)
                .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
                .str.strip()
                .replace({'': None})
                .astype('float')
            )

    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    return df.reset_index(drop=True)

def process(reportsByType) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType.copy()
    df['total'] = df['Fraud'] + df['Identity Theft'] + df['Other']
    df['otherShare'] = df['Other'] / df['total']

    # years already 2001-2024 inclusive, but enforce just in case
    df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2001) & (df['Year'] <= 2024)].copy()

    any_year = bool((df['Other'] > 0.5 * df['total']).any())
    return pd.DataFrame([{'answer': 'Yes' if any_year else 'No'}])
